scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,provider,mcp,web -c cyan,amber,blue,mint "npm run dev -w @hackrails/api" "npm run dev -w @hackrails/provider" "npm run dev -w @hackrails/mcp" "npm run dev -w @hackrails/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hackrails/shared && npm run build -w @hackrails/provider && npm run build -w @hackrails/api && npm run build -w @hackrails/mcp && npm run build -w @hackrails/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hackrails/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hackrails/provider && npm run typecheck -w @hackrails/api && npm run typecheck -w @hackrails/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @hackrails/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hackrails/provider && npm run test -w @hackrails/api
